risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (312.3) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event in 2 days adds near-term volatility, and earnings in 16 days create binary event risk for energy sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: EMA golden crosses (9/21 and 20/50) with 15x volume spike and new 20-day highs create technical confluence that typically precedes sustained moves, and extreme fear (18/100) offers contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stoch, Williams %R), weak ADX trend confirmation, inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels (312.3), earnings binary event in 16 days, and price trading below 50/200 EMAs create a high-risk setup with unfavorable macro backdrop and limited fundamental support.

decision.entry_rationale: While EMA golden crosses and 15x volume spike offer technical confluence, overbought oscillators and weak trend confirmation (ADX false) undermine entry quality in a macro crisis environment.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis levels (312.3), inverted yield curve, and earnings binary event in 16 days create severe tail risk; overbought conditions leave minimal upside room before mean reversion.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical confluence insufficient to overcome macro headwinds and fundamental weakness
